title: Core: AS2 scope chain and variable resolution
description: Test compilation of: (1) local var shadows outer var, (2) function parameter shadows outer var, (3) global variable access via _global.x, (4) this.x vs x (member vs local), (5) with(obj) { x } resolves to obj.x, (6) ActionGetVariable (0x1c) for local/global, ActionGetMember (0x4f) for member. Test that the compiler emits correct opcodes for each scope resolution.
